name.en: UK visa / permission digital face photo
name.zh: 英国签证或许可数字面部照片

notes.en: UKVI guidance (checked 2026-10-12). Verbatim: at least 600 pixels wide and 750 pixels tall; at least 50KB and no more than 6MB; a jpg or jpeg file; plain light-coloured background. Stored: min 600x750 px; JPG/JPEG; 50 KB-6 MB (6 MB recorded as 6144 KB; 1000 vs 1024 not stated). Light-coloured background is not a named hex, so background stays empty. Print millimetres, DPI and head ratio are not in that quote. Missing a named background keeps needs-review.
notes.zh: UKVI 指引（2026-10-12 核对）. 原文: at least 600 pixels wide and 750 pixels tall; at least 50KB and no more than 6MB; a jpg or jpeg file; plain light-coloured background. 只记: 600x750; JPG/JPEG; 50 KB-6 MB. 浅色背景无色值. needs-review.
